activation.note: Activation requires refining ambiguous input into a structured wagon, not merely free-form input or a wagon-file edit. Ambiguity is honestly labeled llm_judged; file-kind and change signals are explicitly non-decisive, with the proposed change observer labeled needs_new_observer. Examples and exclusions retain the source scope.

audit.summary: All 32 segments survive at their claimed destinations, including field definitions, ownership distinctions and the description-length threshold. The shared node contains the complete reusable wagon-theme taxonomy rather than extraction-specific instructions; added rationale and negative restatements are declared, and then expresses one extraction obligation.

segmentChecks.note: The ambiguous-input scope and all eight extraction targets survive across given/when/then; the original statement is also retained in audit.
All field definitions and the description minimum of at least 10 characters survive in prefer, with outcome expressed as measurable progress/result.
The WHO/WHAT meaning and actor:role or entity:state forms are retained verbatim in prefer[0].
Goal remains WHY/motivation and explicitly a single intent statement.
Produce remains owned output artifacts, with the ownership constraint also made explicit in avoid and evidence.
Consume remains input artifacts owned by other wagons, without reversing or weakening the ownership distinction.
The Wagon theme options label opens the shared taxonomy text and is also retained in verifier_detail.
The theme-to-scope mapping is explicit in both prefer[6] and the shared taxonomy.
The mechanic scope is complete and verbatim in the shared node.
The scenario scope is complete and verbatim in the shared node.
The full match scope, including multiplayer coordination and turn management, is retained in the shared node.
The sensory scope is complete and verbatim in the shared node.
The player scope is complete and verbatim in the shared node.
The league scope is complete and verbatim in the shared node.

risks: Theme scopes are available only through the shared-taxonomy pointer; if that node is not loaded, the names alone leave potentially overlapping choices such as match, player, and scenario under-specified.

The fields do not say whether to ask for clarification or infer values when ambiguous input lacks information for a required field; avoiding an unextracted field could encourage a weak planner to guess.

unobservable: task_term: whether input is genuinely ambiguous and is being refined into a structured wagon requires LLM judgement, including judgements about unclear intent, scope, ownership, or success.
change: 'wagon added from ambiguous input' needs a new observer, and linking an observed new wagon definition to ambiguous source input still requires judgement.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the extraction contract and the complete shared theme taxonomy, so I agree with the auditor's PASS. Coder-facing guidance is operational and clear overall, though reliable theme choice depends on loading the shared node and activation necessarily retains LLM-judged ambiguity plus an unimplemented change observer.
